description: Windows Dynamic Island with media controls, system monitoring, calendar, notes, tasks, alarms, and quick controls.
notes: The official Dlives_Setup.exe is a PyInstaller-based installer, not an Inno Setup installer. The upstream installer.spec bundles Dlives_Payload.bin, which is a copy of the standalone one-file Dlives.exe built by DLives.spec. Scoop downloads that standalone executable directly and does not run the interactive vendor installer.

The manifest pins the upstream commit that contains the payload. checkver tracks the latest commit changing Dlives_Payload.bin, and autoupdate downloads that exact commit's payload. The current binary's SHA-256 was verified against the embedded payload extracted from the official Setup executable.
The application stores user data under %APPDATA%\\Dlives. Its own Start with Windows option can write a per-user Run key when enabled in the app; Scoop does not enable that option.
